ios.desc:
You know that feeling…

⇒ It’s the Sunday scaries before a work week
⇒ It’s seeing your to-do list grow on Monday morning
⇒ It’s the spontaneous Zoom call you felt completely unprepared for
⇒ It’s the difficult feedback you need to give someone but aren’t sure how

You never know what your day is going to throw at you, but if you spend just *** 2 minutes *** a day on Bunch, you’ll be prepared for anything.

Here’s what you’ll get:

⇒ Daily tips & practice scenarios to build key career & leadership skills
⇒ Micro courses from world-class experts designed to help with the specific challenges you’re facing at work
⇒ On-demand advice and support from experts for tough situations

…All that plus the support of an entire community dedicated to getting 1% better every day!

Our promise to you: Everything you see on Bunch will be…

⇒ Personalized to your specific needs
⇒ Straight to the point, no-fluff
⇒ Actionable enough to use it today
⇒ Based on the experience of real experts
⇒ Doable in chunks of just a few minutes!

Top 5 signs you should get BUNCH…

=> You love to learn but don't have time to read every book or comb through every HBR article
=> You want to empower those around you to do their best work but don’t know how
=> You’re frustrated with your team: missed deadlines, re-work, slow progress
=> You keep running into the same problems on project after project
=> It feels like there’s always too much work and not enough time

Over 72,000 managers and other aspiring leaders have already joined the Bunch community, and our movement is just getting started! Here’s what others are saying:

"After using BUNCH for a few months, I find it to be a helpful tool with constantly new and updated tips on leadership, it is eye opening for me in fields I have not explored before. I can recommend it to anyone responsible for a team's performance. Added bonus is that it comes with a community of leaders I can discuss related-topics with, and get specific advice." - Nader Alexan, CTO @ Airteam

"I've been a BUNCH user for months now, and there aren't many services that I'm this excited about! I genuinely believe it can be the lever to catapult your career or business - especially if you don't have time to read all the latest management books and HBR articles, but you still need to lead people in your work." - Srđan Stanić, Software Engineer at Gravitus
